title: Cloud infrastructure startup Render raised a $100M Series C extension led by Georgian Partners at a $1.5B valuation, and says 4.5M+ developers use its tools (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
summary: Jordan Novet / CNBC: Cloud infrastructure startup Render raised a $100M Series C extension led by Georgian Partners at a $1.5B valuation, and says 4.5M+ developers use its tools — Venture capitalists are doubling down on Render, a startup offering easy-to-use cloud infrastructure.
